scope: Version 1.2 plan coverage, priorities, dependencies, authorization boundaries and acceptance criteria; not implementation or model acceptance.
checks: Previously confirmed corrections, local invalidation, deterministic facts, domain/finding scope, tool descriptions, timeouts, model capacity, summaries/grouping, runtime/merge/Agents/severity are included.
Latest assets/owner permissions, evidence index generation and necessary reads are included; fixed function permissions/TLS/source-host preservation are regressions only.
12 repair entries, M0-M4, V12-A-G and pending task mappings are consistent.
4096/8192 remain candidates; cumulative budgets/call limits and new public-table privileges are not treated as approved.
Database/relationship/GET acceptance is distinct from UI navigation; auto-refresh, priority queues, cross-case Neo4j and universal retries remain deferred.
Historical failures/tasks remain unchanged in meaning; conflicting older specs must be updated before implementation.
implementation_priorities: At M1/M2, fix the partial-result adoption contract and per-path budgets including Deep, grouped selection, C3 and C6 correction. C6 correction shares the remaining deadline and cannot extend the whole Run.
review_method: Read local files only; no reviewer file edits, network, database or model operations.
limitations: Approval covers the plan review, not new implementation, database authorizations, test quotas or release.
Existing unfinished overall quality and dual-backend tasks are not closed by naming version 1.2.
